findings.message: Stream 1 is coded as PCM (format tag 0x0001), which has no parser here; its media objects are not analyzed.
The file holds a Media Object Index Object but no Media Object Index Parameters Object in its header, which the specification requires (section 4.10).
The file holds a Timecode Index Object but no Timecode Index Parameters Object in its header, which the specification requires (section 4.11).
